'''Shorwarr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who used the title of [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and worked as a [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Shorwarr made his living mainly by hunting [[Nexu/Legends|Nexu]], a predatory [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cholganna/Legends|Cholganna]]. He was well known throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] as a purveyor of exotic animals, and was also known to be one of the few individuals to actually travel to Cholganna, where he maintained a hidden base known as [[Camp Danger]]. Shorwarr was willing to act as a guide for other wishing to hunt Nexu, although he had an extremely quick temper and did not tolerate betrayal of any kind from those he worked with. He flew an [[ILH-KK Citadel-class civilian cruiser|ILH-KK ''Citadel''-class civilian cruiser]] named ''[[Starblue Ranger]]'' which was customised to include cages and storage lockers in the hull. While hunting he made use of a [[Bowcaster/Legends|Bowcaster]], a [[Bola/Legends|Bola]] and a [[Ryyk blade/Legends|Ryyk blade]].<ref name="BTR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shorwarr first appeared in [[2013]] in ''[[Beyond the Rim]]'', an adventure module written by [[Sterling Hershey]] for the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] roleplaying game, ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]''. He did not feature in the main story which the book revolved around but was included as a character for use in further campaigns extending from the included campaign.
